# Draft:The Kingdom of Danoria

Kingdom of Danoria
The Kingdom of Danoria is a sovereign micronation located within estates in Malaysia and Singapore. With a total area of 0.001214 km2, Danoria is amongst one of the smallest nations on earth. Consisting of 7 provinces that are considered to be residential estates, Danoria is a flourishing micronation with plentiful amounts of amenities within the capital estate, Aegitia. The country's average temperature is 27°C
The country consists of 57 people in total: 17 people in which are legitimate residents living within the national boundaries whereas the remaining 40 are registered civilians who were obliged into joining the country. The motto of the country is Unity and Strength brings destiny. English and Chinese are generally spoken by Danorian civilians.
Similarly to Morocco, Danoria's government is run by semi-constitutional monarchy, meaning that although elections are to be held every 4 years, the king will be having the same amount of power as the elected prime minister. Danoria is considered to be a sophisticated micronation, having passport and IC card systems, a national currency as well as many mini-amenities located in the capital estate's rooms.
Being culturally diverse as well, Danoria's ethnic composition consists of 78.95% Chinese (45 Chinese), 7.02% Indians (4 Indians) and 14.04% Malays (8 Malays). Danoria's religion composition consists of 42.11% Christians (24 Christians) , 7.02% Hindi (4 Hindus) , 14.04% Muslims (8 Muslims) , 33.33% Buddhists (20 Buddhists) and 1.75% non religious (1 non religious person). The country's national animal is rabbit, its national flower is pussy willow and it's national sport is badminton. In addition to that, it also has a national cuisine, that being egg fried rice.
The country has multiple national holidays, that being New Years Day on 1 January, Chinese New Year on 10-12 February, King Daniel's Birthday on 27 April, Deepavali on 12 November, Christmas on December 25, Vesak on May 12, National Day on 29 November 2024 and Hari Raya Aidilfitri on 31 April to 2 April.
The country uses Denari as its national currency and does not have a state religion. The government permits multiple nationalities and the country's time zone is UTC+8. The country has numerous amounts of amenities within it's boundaries, a postal service, a standing military which uses nerf guns as weapons as well as a mini-space agency center.
History
Spanning across 7 estates in Malaysia and Singapore, the Kingdom of Danoria has a rather rich background of history and culture. The country's capital is Aegitia and it's civilians generally speak English and Chinese. The country's government system is constitutional monarchy, meaning that a prime minister is to be elected by the civilians every 4 years. Although the country was initially established on 16 November 2023, king Daniel abandoned it's original state as he lost interests in sustaining it's short lived independence, hence, it was temporarily disbanded by him on 24 March 2024.
On 29 November 2024, king Daniel re-established the country under the governance of absolute monarchy. The nation first started off humble, only having control over half of his bedroom as well as the guest room. King Daniel then started to have expansionist goals on December, compromising an agreement with his father to be able to control the back balcony at the expense of having to water the plants everyday on 5 December. The very day after, he once again compromised the same thing to gain control over the front balcony as well. On 13 December, he compromised with his parents for them to cede all their territories under Danorian control at the expense of him having to fulfull their imposed conditions. Afterward, king Daniel decided to annex basically the entire house excluding the other half of his bedroom and his brother's territory, effectively giving him control over 90% of his house.
Upon the Danorian conquest of 90% of his condominium, king Daniel subsequently decided to expand Danorian territory through the means of mutual agreements with his family members. On 21-22 December 2024, he inquired his family members to sign their signatures on a contract that would have registered their territory as a part of Danoria, expanding king Daniel's Territory. The Danorian government then introduced multiple customs to the country, such as an official law book, a national currency, an identity card as well as passport systems. With the new uproar of the rise of development in Danoria, king Daniel managed to establish services and amenities within his country's capital (or his house):
1.A store with saleable items in the guest room
2.A national archive display center in the office
3.A mini government office in his room's study table
4.A mini-library in the office
5.A mini science center in the front balcony
6.A space agency center in the guest room
7.A military exhibition center
8.An art musuem
9.A restaurant (which is practically just the dining area)
10.An international souvenir display
11.A post office in the office
12.A technological exhibition center in the guest room
13.A gallery of board games
14.A national map center in his room
On 3 January 2025, king Daniel declared the abolishment of the absolute monarchy and the establishment of the new government being run by constitutional monarchy, allowing elections to occur. The establishment of the new hybrid government meant that King Daniel had the same amount of power as the elected prime minister. As of right now, the Kingdom of Danoria exhibits a formidable military, consisting of 12 recruits equipped with nerf guns. The country also has bicycle helmets repurposed to be soldier helmets and body armor made out of cardboard. Apart from that, Danoria additionally has bottle rockets made for the national space agency and is still striving for national development!
Timeline of Danorian History
16 November 2023 - Danoria is first established under a the governance of a republic
24 March 2023 - Danoria is temporarily disbanded by king Daniel
29 November 2024- Danoria is re-established under the governance of absolute monarchy
5 December 2024- King Daniel compromises with his father to control the front balcony
6 December 2024- King Daniel compromises with his father again to control the back balcony
13 December 2024- King Daniel compromises with his parents to be able to exert Danorian control over their territories
21-22 December 2024- King Daniel drafts an agreement for his relatives to be able to expand his territory
3 January 2025- King Daniel declares the abolishment of the absolute monarchy and the establishment of constitutional monarchy for the country's government. Apart from that, he also compromises with his mandrin tuition's manager to expand his territory
14-15 January 2025- King Daniel drafts a contract for his bahasa tuition's manager to expand Danorian territory
21 January 2025- Danoria launches it's first water rocket, entitled Hermes, approximately 6 meters up the air.
23 January 2025- The National Statue of Technology is erected by the Danorian Government.
24 January 2025- National Football Team of Danoria gets established
25 January 2025- Cardboard robots Phil and Bob are assembled by the Danorian Government. Phil can be found in the capital province of Aegitia whereas Bob has been relocated to the province of Sentixa.
31 January 2025- Si Yu is inaugurated as the first Danorian Prime Minister.
The King
The permanent king of Danoria is King Daniel Guok. He is responsible for the creation of this nation. Apart from instituting the creation of Danoria, he also managed to massively develop the country as well as implement multiple services such as postal services as well as establish many mini-amenities within the country's capital city, Aegitia.
Powers and Responsibilites of the King
The king of Danoria, unlike in other countries governed by constitutional monarchy, has powers similar to that of the prime minister. Although king Daniel is in possession of political power, he will not be able to breach constitutions such as the prohibition of the declaration of war against other nations or micronations. The king has many responsibilities such as sustaining the country, water plants every day as well as establishing new laws and constitutions. Impeachment of the king will be carried out if king Daniel bypasses any of the constitutions.
National Symbols
The National Flag
The National Flag of Danoria is made of a few colours: Red, yellow, white and black. Black serves as the base background color, yellow is stretched across the entire flag, bordered by a red outline and a central emblem displaying a shield shaped emblem with a diagonal red colored cross is shown in the center. The black in the flag symbolizes bravery and courage, red symbolizes power,yellow symbolizes royalty as well the prevalent monarchy in the country, and white symbolizes purity and strength. The cross shown in the flag is to represent neutrality and the shield emblem represents defense, courage and patriotism.
The National Arms
The national arms of Danoria consists of an ornamental border, a crown and a shield. The golden ornamental border symbolizes nobility, the shield displaying the flag of Danoria encourages patriotism and the crown on top of it symbolizes royalty.
National Animal: Rabbit
National Flower: Pussy Willow
National Food: Egg Fried Rice
National Sport: Badminton
Danorian Prime Ministers
On 3 January 2025, king Daniel declared the abolishment of the absolute monarchy Danoria was initially being governed from and established the new government being run by constitutional monarchy. This would have enabled Danorian elections to be held every 4 years, electing a prime minister to be in charge of partially controlling the country. As of 2025-2029, prime minister Si Yu is to be placed in charge of being the first prime minister of Danoria.
Powers and Responsibilities of the Prime Minister
The prime minister of Danoria will be having similar powers as the King, being in possession of political and economical power. The prime minister is to be responsible for politically securing Danoria as well as giving ideas for constitutional laws for the country. The prime minister, like the king, is unable to bypass important constitutions set for the country to prevent corruption. If the prime minister bypasses the constitution, he will be impeached.
Currency
The National Currency of Danoria is Denari, which is primarily used for the purchase of items and food in the country. Denari has nothing to do with the Roman Empire's currency, being Denarius or Denarii, the idea for the currency's name just randomly emerged in King Daniel's head. The value of 1 Denari is equivalent to 0.45684 USD or 2 Malaysian Ringgit.
The vibrancy of each note varies, the one Denari note is coloured in red and orange, the five Denari note is coloured in orange and yellow, the ten Denari note is coloured in green, the twenty Denari note is coloured in turquoise and light blue, the fifty Denari note is coloured in light and dark blue, and the hundred Denari is coloured in purple. In addition to that, Danoria's currency also includes coins. 5 cents is coloured in light grey, 10 cents is coloured in silver, 20 cents is coloured in bronze, and 50 cents is coloured in gold.
National Football Team
Consisting of a team of 7 players ( including the king himself) , the National Football Team of Danoria competes in friendly matches and local tournaments, representing the spirit and unity of Danoria. The team, led by the king, shows a sense of sportsmanship, teamwork, and the promotion of national pride.
Football Team Mascot
The mascot of the National Football team is a pig bolster called "Char Siew. Named after a chinese pork cuisine, Char Siew represents cultural diversity. The pig bolster is beloved by fans and often seen at matches, where it serves as a playful reminder of unity and shared identity through the nation's traditions.
Identification Systems
Apart from having a national currency, the Kingdom of Danoria also has identification systems implemented to increase national security.
Passport The Kingdom of Danoria exhibits a passport system, which can be aquired by citizens through asking the king into giving them in the government office. Danorian passports, similarly to Malaysian's, are coloured in red on the front and back cover and are embellished with a golden coloured Danorian coat of arms.
Identity Card The Kingdom of Danoria exhibits an identity card system, which can be aquired by citizens through asking the king into giving them in the government office.
National Anthem
Danoria our Homeland is the national anthem and is a proud and symbolic song which serves as a representation of the nation's identity, history and values. The national anthem's main purpose is to increase the sense of patriotism and unity among Danorian citizens. The sample used for the national anthem is  "Oceania, 'Tis for Thee", the supposed national anthem for the fictional country of Oceania in the book, 1984. Although Oceania is a clear example of an authoritarian regime controlling a large amount of the world's population, Danoria has little to no correlation to the fictional fascist regime and is a partially democratic country.
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vCkU379lHZM National Anthem - Danoria Our Homeland]
Lyrics
Danoria is our precious homeland,
Where unity and hope shall stand.
Through trials bright, our hearts hold true,
With strength anew, we shall pursue.
Our banner waves in skies so free,
A land of dreams and harmony.
Danoria, Danoria, Danoria our homeland
Together we rise, strong and grand,
Forever united, our hearts command.

National Cultures
The Kingdom of Danoria exhibits multiple cultures as well as different religions due to the diversity in it's population. Danoria's ethnic composition consists of 78.68% Chinese, 6.55% Indians and 13.11% Malays. Danoria's religion composition consists of 40.98% Christians, 6.55% Hindi, 13.11% Muslims, 34.42% Buddhists and 1.63% other. Because Danoria is predominantly made out of a Chinese population, the country's national dances include the lion dance and other Chinese dances. Apart from that, Danoria has many cultural fashions for each type of culture respectively:
Malay Fashion
The traditional attire of Malay men is called baju melayu, which is a loose tunic paired with trousers and a sarong which is known as sampin. Men also wear the traditional hat, called songkok or kopiah with it. Some men prefer wearing batik shirts with trousers.
The ancient traditional dress for Malay women was kemban, which included sarongs tied above the chest. The current traditional dress for women is baju kurung, which comprises of a knee-length, full-sleeved blouse and a long skirt called kain. The skirt is pleated on one side. This attire is usually accompanied by a scarf on the head. A semi formal version is the kebaya, which is a skin-fit two piece costume.
Chinese Fashion
Although Chinese are the most prominent ethnic group in Danoria, most of the people from the Chinese community residing in Danoria don’t dress traditionally. They prefer to dress casual. However, during festivals, specially the Chinese New Year, they are spotted in traditional outfits.
Chinese men in Danoria wear their traditional dress called tang suit. Tang suit is a type of jacket that has a collar and a knot at the belly and is mostly floral. It has been named after the Tang empire, by overseas Chinese people. The name was suggested because the Tang empire was so powerful that the foreigners called Chinese “Tang people”.
Chinese women in Danoria wear cheongsam (means ‘long dress’) during festivals and formal events. Cheongsam, also called qipao, is a silk one piece dress with a collar and clasps at the waist, either in the center or on the side. Elder women dress in samfoo, which is a type of ankle length pant with a loose fitted top with clasps at the centre. Another popular traditional outfit is worn by Chinese women in Danoria is hanfu, which is a combination of a loose blouse and a long skirt and a belt sash.
Indian Fashion
Indian men in Danoria wear kurta-pyjama, dhoti-kurta or lungi-kurta. Kurta is typically a knee length shirt. Another popular version of kurta is sherwani, which is worn during weddings and other festivals. Dhoti and lungi are types of baggy lowers.
Most Indian women in Danoria wear saree and blouse. Sari is a six yard piece of cloth, draped around the body in a way that it looks like a skirt with pleats in the center and part of the same cloth covers one shoulder and hangs below till the knees. Some women also wear salwar kurta, which is a tunic worn with loose bottoms and long scarf called dupatta.
National Creations
The Kingdom of Danoria is responsible for the creation of a few cardboard robots as well as a statue made from cardboard. Below is the full list of authentic creations built by the Danorian government.
The Statue of Technology
Standing at a height of 77cm ( or 0.77m ) tall, the statue of technology was assembled from cardboard pieces and is one of the most exquisite views Danoria has to offer. The statue of technology is located in the living room next to a storage drawer and it's robotic design represents the technological development of Danoria. The cardboard robot statue is embelished with a Danorian flag, 4 coloured buttons, and is segregated into different body parts; the head, being mostly covered with the face of the robot, makes up around one third of it's body proportions, the torso makes up around one third of it's body proportions, and the statue's arm is around the same size and length of the robot's legs. The statue of technology symbolizes Danoria's technological and national advancements and inspires patriotism among Danorian civilians for the amount of effort implemented by the government to erect this statue.
Phil, the Cardboard Robot
Standing at a height of 61 cm ( or 0.61 m ) tall, Phil is a cardboard robot built by king Daniel and is a proud citizen of the kingdom of Danoria. Phil is decorated with a name tag, 4 coloured buttons, a Danorian flag and is segregated into different body parts; the head, being mostly covered with the face of the robot, makes up around one fourth of it's body proportions, and Phil's arm is around the same size and length of his legs. Phil is proud to be a civilian under the government of Danoria, and can be found in the province of Aegitia!
Bob, the Cardboard Robot
Standing at a height of 61 cm ( or 0.61 m ) tall, Bob is a cardboard robot built by king Daniel and is a proud citizen of the kingdom of Danoria. Bob is decorated with a name tag, 4 coloured buttons, a Danorian flag and is segregated into different body parts; the head, being mostly covered with the face of the robot, makes up around one fourth of it's body proportions, and Bob's arm is around the same size and length of his legs. Bob is proud to be a civilian under the government of Danoria, and can be found in the province of Sentixa!
Business Companies
In order to alleviate the country's economy, the Kingdom of Danoria has implemented multiple business companies within the country. Business companies of Danoria are as of follows:
National Agricultural Business
The National Agricultural Business of Danoria focuses on harvesting practices on plants located on both the front and back balcony of Danoria and promotes local food production to ensure economic growth within the micronation.
National Stamp Company
The National Stamp Company of Danoria focuses on the production of stamps, being priced at 0.10 Denari (or 10 cents) to ensure economical growth within the country. Manufactured postcard stamps are sold at the shop, which is located in the guest room.
National Newspaper Agency
The National Newspaper Agency focuses on the production of reliable double-sided paged newspapers, being priced at 0.50 Denari (or 50 cents) to ensure economical growth as well as an enhanced quality of convenience in Danoria. Manufactured newspapers are sold at the shop , which is located in the guest room
Danorian Trading Company
The Danorian Trading Company oversees the trading of items for money. The Danorian Trading Company also facilitates and regulates transactions, ensuring fair trade. Trades can be conducted in the Government Office.
National Government
Danoria's semi-constitutional monarchist government enables elections to be held every 4 years, meaning that the representative of the winning political party will be elected to become the prime minister. The political parties of Danoria are as follows:
1.The Democratic Party of Danoria
-Representative:Si Yu
2.The Republican Party of Danoria
-Representative:Goh Kim
3.The Nationalist Party of Danoria
-Representative: Unknown (not specified)
The elected prime minister is only able to reign the country for 2 periods. Impeachment will be carried out if the elected prime minister reigns longer than 3 years or make amendments to constitutions regarding their reign.
Powers and Responsibilities of the Prime Minister
The prime minister of Danoria will be having similar powers as the King, being in possession of political and economical power. The prime minister is to be responsible for politically securing Danoria as well as giving ideas for constitutional laws for the country. The prime minister, like the king, is unable to bypass important constitutions set for the country to prevent corruption. If the prime minister bypasses the constitution, he will be impeached.

Danorian Constitutions
On 20 December 2024, king Daniel decided to establish constitutions and laws for the country to prevent corruption from emerging. The full list of national laws are as follows:
Law 1: Country's governance
-This country's government is constitutional monarchy. Other than that, king Daniel will be the permanent king of Danoria.
Law 2:Taxes
-Coin taxes will be imposed to all citizens of this country. The king is to be collecting all coins seen in proterties partially controlled by Daniel.
Law 3:Stealing
-Anyone caught stealing coins or money owned by Daniel will be fined additionally.
Law 4:Conspiring against the government
-People who are caught conspiring or revolting against the government will the expelled from Danorian citizenship.
Law 5:Restricted Areas
-Some restricted areas have been set up by the government throughout the country's territory. A fine ranging from 20 to 50 cents will be imposed to outsiders or not fully registered citizens if they trespass restricted boundaries without permission.
Law 6:Passport
-Civilians of this country aren't allowed to enter restricted areas unless given authority. To circumvent this issue, citizens can ask for a passport from the government, which will give them enhanced authority to enter restricted areas.
Law 7:Job occupations
-Job occupations implemented by the government are:
1.Gardener
2.Chef
3.Janitor
4.Teacher
5.Guard
6.Soldier
7.Government official
Law 8:The Constitution
-Since Danoria's government is constitutional monarchy, elections will be held every 4 years on 5th September. Inauguration will be officiated on 5th January. The elected prime minister will have the same amount of power over the country as the king. Both the prime minister and the king would be in possession of political power, although they wouldn't be able to amend constitutional laws as follows:
1.No prime minister would be able to reign for more than 4 years.
2.Declaration of war is prohibited unless given justification
3.Any president or king who breach these constitutions will be impeached
Law 9:National Holidays:
-National Holidays or Danoria are:
New Year's Day - 1 January
Chinese New Year - February 10-12
King Daniel's Birthday - April 27
National Day - November 29
Deepavali - November 12
Christmas - December 25
Vesak - May 12
Hari Raya Aidilfitri - March 31- April 2
Law 10: National Language
-The national language of this country is English and Chinese
Law 11-Nationalities
-The government permits citizens to have multiple nationalities
Law 12-Felonies and Crimes
-If anyone within the Danorian government commits a felony or crime, they will be permanently expelled and exiled to the Malaysian court for their judgement. Crimes include murder, assault, domestic violence, homicide, burglary, theft, vandalism, fraud, driving under the influence, rape, child abuse and phishing. Felonies include attempted murder, possession of weapons and conspiracy to commit a crime.
Law 13-Forgery of the law
-Anyone caught forging the law will be expelled from the country
Law 14-Consumption of Alcohol
-Anyone above the age of 13 are allowed to drink very small amounts of alcohol, whereas anyone above the age of 21 are allowed to drink large amounts of alcohol.
Law 15:State Religion
-The country does not have an official state religion.
